newsitem.title: GERMANY: Jochimsen says Buba must keep policy role until EMU.
newsitem.headline: Jochimsen says Buba must keep policy role until EMU.

text.p: Bundesbank council member Reimut Jochimsen said on Friday the central bank must retain its powers over policy until they are passed to a future European central bank.

"Until the European central bank starts business, the Bundesbank must keep its full ability to conduct policy," Jochimsen, who is also president of the state central bank in North Rhine-Westphalia, told a news conference.

Jochimsen also said he was "very irritated" at reported moves by the European parliament to amend the stability and growth pact designed to ensure fiscal discipline after European monetary union (EMU) begins.
"That could also cause a lot of problems for the German government which has placed emphasis on the need for automatic sanctions," Jochimsen said.
The Financial Times reported on Friday that the European parliament had pushed through amendments which weakened the stability pact.
